name: Vine climb up

v1.prompt: The cat climbs straight up a thick vertical vine, seen from the side: body vertical, head up, front paws reach up and grip in turn, back legs push. The cat stays centred in the frame while climbing in place; the vine is a green vertical rope right in front of the cat's belly. Seamless loop.  Static camera, no zoom, pan or tilt; strict side view. Keep the exact painting style, colours, light and outline of the image. The cat stays the same size in every frame.

verdict: usable: convincing in-place climb, but the vine is baked into every frame (olive green, colour-keyable) and frame 0 has a white bg-removal leftover
suggest: 25 frames (recut f24-48, closing IoU 0.88) at 14 fps; key out the vine
